name: com.coffeebean.tools
description: Standalone utility module for the CoffeeBean framework: thread-safe singleton, MonoSingleton, Unity main-thread dispatcher, thread-pool runner, native in-app review (iOS StoreKit / Google Play In-App Review) and native device region/language. No dependency on other CoffeeBean modules.

samples.description: 工具模块示例：单例、后台线程投递到主线程、延迟执行、线程池限流。
